text_block_list.text:
A few days after attaining her goal of
entering
the Classics, Мэдзиро Райан is
faced with burnout
from her constant
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unlike Ryan, Ines Fujin has entered the
world of
racing from a life where she had
very little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She lets Ryan know that her motivation
for racing
stems from a genuine desire to
run for the sake of
her family.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her own motivation rekindled by
this talk,
Ryan is now ready to enter the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
